language_task: Place the toys on the plate with no collisions.
outcome_evidence: Initially, three toys lie beside the empty plate (frame 0, overhead_cam and wrist_cam). The robot transfers and releases the beige toy onto the plate (frames 257–274), then the pink toy (frames 550–570), and finally the blue toy (frames 830–850), as shown in overhead_cam and wrist_cam. All three remain on the plate after the empty gripper withdraws (frames 870–912, both cameras). No unwanted collision, failed acquisition, or unintended scene disturbance is visibly established.
